fields.Name: Bill.com - Get Invoices
fields.Description: Retrieves a single Invoices record from Bill.com by its external ID

fields.Name: ExternalID
fields.Description: The unique ID of the Invoices record to retrieve

fields.Name: CompanyIntegrationID
fields.Description: Optional: specific CompanyIntegration to use

fields.Name: Record
fields.Description: The retrieved Invoices record with all fields

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: BILL-generated ID of the invoice. The value begins with `00e`.

fields.Name: archived
fields.Description: Set as `true` if the invoice is archived

fields.Name: recordStatus
fields.Description: Record Status value from the retrieved record

fields.Name: invoiceNumber
fields.Description:
User-generated invoice number. This value can be your chosen number scheme.

If you do not set this field, `invoiceNumber` is auto-generated.

fields.Name: invoiceDate
fields.Description:
Invoice creation date. This value is in the `yyyy-MM-dd` format.

If you do not set this field, `invoiceDate` is set as the date when the invoice is created.

fields.Name: dueDate
fields.Description:
Invoice due date. The value is in the `yyyy-MM-dd` format.

If you do not set this field, `dueDate` is set as the date when the invoice is created.

fields.Name: paymentTermId
fields.Description: Payment Term Id value from the retrieved record

fields.Name: customerId
fields.Description: BILL-generated ID of the customer. The value begins with `0cu`.

fields.Name: totalAmount
fields.Description: Invoice total amount

fields.Name: dueAmount
fields.Description: Invoice due amount. The value is calculated by subtracting any applied credits (`creditAmount`), scheduled payment (`scheduledAmount`), and cleared payment from `totalAmount`.

fields.Name: scheduledAmount
fields.Description: Invoice scheduled amount. The value is set as the customer payment amount that is pending clearance.

fields.Name: creditAmount
fields.Description:
Credit amount applied to the invoice.

When a credit amount is applied to an invoice, the invoice `status` is set as `PARTIAL_PAYMENT` or `PAID_IN_FULL` depending on the invoice `totalAmount`.

fields.Name: status
fields.Description: Status value from the retrieved record

fields.Name: exchangeRate
fields.Description: Invoice exchange rate

fields.Name: createdBy
fields.Description: BILL-generated ID of the user that created the invoice. The value begins with `006`.

fields.Name: createdTime
fields.Description: Invoice created time

fields.Name: updatedTime
fields.Description: Invoice updated time

fields.Name: invoiceLineItems
fields.Description: Invoice line item information

fields.Name: payToChartOfAccountId
fields.Description: BILL-generated ID of the chart of accounts for the invoice payment. The value begins with `0ca`.

fields.Name: payments
fields.Description: Invoice payments information

fields.Name: classifications
fields.Description: Classifications value from the retrieved record

fields.Name: salesTaxItemId
fields.Description: BILL-generated ID of the `SALES_TAX` item. The value begins with `0ii`. The tax rate is applied to all the invoice line items set as taxable.

fields.Name: salesTaxTotal
fields.Description: Invoice sales tax amount. The value is set based on `salesTaxItemId`.

fields.Name: salesTaxPercentage
fields.Description: Invoice sales tax percentage. The value is set based on `salesTaxItemId`.

fields.Name: enableCardPayment
fields.Description: Set as `true` if the card payment option is enabled for the invoice

fields.Name: convenienceFee
fields.Description: Convenience Fee value from the retrieved record

fields.Name: invoicePdfId
fields.Description:
BILL-generated ID of the invoice PDF. The value begins with `att`.

The invoice PDF is sent as an email attachment when you send an invoice to a customer. The invoice PDF also appears when the customer clicks the invoice payment link to complete the in...

fields.Name: customer
fields.Description: Customer the invoice is issued to, as an InvoiceCustomer object — {"id":"0cu…"}, NOT a bare ID string. Write-only: BILL returns the same value flattened to `customerId` on read.
Get operation completed successfully
